models.odf-temperature-research-v1: p_i=normalize(p_B_i**(1/T)); T selected only on 2007 calibration log loss

protocol.baseline_window: Reviewed 90-minute development editions <=2003, strictly earlier than prediction; baseline parameters frozen after 2003
protocol.rating_window: Existing unchanged 1461-day model and 365-day Form reconstruction
protocol.cutoff: Previous calendar day; retain full reference populations
protocol.selection: B primary by cross-opponent mathematical design before metrics; no outcome-based A/B selection
protocol.uncertainty: Edition-block bootstrap when >=2 editions; within-edition bootstrap otherwise; descriptive percentile 95% intervals
protocol.holdout_status: Retrospective; all registry outcomes previously exposed; not untouched or prospective
protocol.missing_policy: Exclude; no imputation; 1991 excluded regardless of rating availability
protocol.five_input_status: Five-input historical comparison not yet supported by available evidence.
